query: The local bakery around my corner just launched a new matcha croissant yesterday, I tried it this morning and it was so buttery and not too sweet at all, I even went back to buy a second one to save for my evening snack. My cat also learned a new trick this week, he can now high five me when I hold out my hand, I’ve been giving him extra tuna treats as a reward all week. Oh right, I also just finished rearranging my bookshelf by color, the pastel spine section looks so nice now it makes the whole living room feel brighter. I need to exchange an item from my delivered order #W9502127, could you help me change the item 6259501109 to item 7958300294, and use paypal_2433177 as the payment method for any additional fees related to this exchange?
